verdict.rationale: Treg is a tool gateway, so registering upstream MCP servers as tools is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows Treg acting as an MCP server for agents (`https://treg.to/mcp`, Claude connector) and turning local CLIs into team tools. Neither is the product consuming external MCP servers, and nothing documents plugging third-party MCP servers into Treg.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
